focus.label: Lung cancer progression
focus.why: Prior smoking and lung cancer therapy (node-2) support recurrence; left lower low breath sounds (node-4) suggests local lesion; tachycardia (node-3) supports severity.

payload.analysis: CTPA reveals a mediastinal mass compressing bilateral pulmonary arteries with right heart enlargement, consistent with lung cancer progression given prior malignancy and smoking history. This mass explains the dyspnea, tachycardia, and tricuspid murmur; no pulmonary embolism was identified, downgrading that secondary concern. All key imaging information is covered.
